text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** A plated lunch: pan-fried liver slices with a tomato and crumb topping, wilted spinach with a little rice and a dark piece of mushroom or meat, and sautéed green beans. The olives, tomatoes and carrots on the side plate at the left are not counted.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A square white dinner plate, about 26 cm per side. Because it is square, I used side × side rather than the circle formula: 26 × 26 ≈ 676 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Liver slices with topping
- Wilted spinach
- Rice
- Mushroom/meat piece
- Green beans
- Cooking oil (visible sheen)

**STEP 4 - Area (food covers about 30% of the plate):**

| Item | % of plate | Area (cm²) |
|---|---|---|
| Liver | ~8% | 55 |
| Spinach | ~6% | 40 |
| Rice | ~3% | 20 |
| Mushroom/meat | ~2% | 12 |
| Green beans | ~8% | 50 (loose) |
| **Total** | **~27–30%** | |

**STEPS 5–7 - Volume, grams and energy:**

| Item | Volume | Density (g/ml) | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Liver | 55 cm² × 1.3 cm ≈ 72 ml | 1.0 | ~72 g (with topping) | 175 | 126 |
| Spinach (cooked, wilted) | 40 cm² × 2 cm = 80 ml | ~0.4 | 32 g | 30 | 10 |
| Rice | 20 cm² × 1 cm = 20 ml | 0.8 | 16 g | 130 | 21 |
| Mushroom/meat | 12 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 14 ml | 1.0 | 14 g | 100 | 14 |
| Green beans | 50 cm² × 1.5 cm = 75 ml | 0.5 | 38 g | 45 | 17 |
| Oil | — | — | ~5 g | 884 | 44 |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 177 g and 232 kcal. That is plausible for a modest portion covering only about 30% of the plate.
